description: Project-scoped storage commit messages; migration skips OS junk files; include-path accepts in-project absolute paths
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- Storage-repo commit subjects now carry the project as a conventional scope — `chore(<project>): record journal`, `chore(<project>): archive task <name>`, `chore(<project>): import external workflow data` — so the shared `~/.trellis-wiki` log names its owner. A custom `session_commit_message` keeps any explicit scope; unscoped conventional messages get the project scope injected automatically.

**Bug Fixes:**
- `trellis update --migrate-storage` skips OS junk files (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`) across copy, digest, verification and product-file enumeration, and reports the skipped count. Previously a global gitignore ignoring `.DS_Store` made the import's `git add` fail deterministically with a misleading "Git identity/hooks/locks" error.
- `add_session.py --include-path` accepts absolute paths inside the project's data directory — the form platform docs receive after template rendering — and all ref validation now runs before any journal write, so argument errors no longer leave a half-recorded session behind.
notes: Patch release. No file migrations required; existing projects pick up the new commit-message scope after `trellis-wiki update` refreshes their scripts.
